title: Integration Architect
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners choose which sales systems to integrate and route three story data flows between them, then see their architecture drawn as a diagram with valid and misrouted flows highlighted.

learningObjectives: Design a story integration architecture by selecting which systems to integrate (CRM, LMS, CMS) and defining the data flow between them.
prerequisites: Story Integration, CRM Integration, and Sales Enablement Platforms sections of Chapter 10

keyQuestions: Design a story integration architecture by selecting which systems to integrate (CRM, LMS, CMS) and defining the data flow between them.
assessmentOpportunities: A valid architecture: CRM, Sales Enablement, and Analytics with all three flows routed correctly.
Learner can explain why performance data must flow back to the enablement platform.
